watch.summary: While playing an egg-rolling physics game, the streamer tries to remember the number five by listing things that come in fives, accidentally saying he has five fingers before realizing he has ten.

beats.what: The streamer counts as the egg rolls along narrow tracks.
He gets frustrated at failing early and tries to memorize rolling off at count five.
He says 'You have five fingers... wait, I have ten!'
He bursts into uncontrollable laughter at his own stupidity.
He attempts to fix his logic while still chuckling and continuing the run.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Five... no, I have ten, sorry!
watch.why: The comedy stems from a natural brain fart and the creator's immediate, contagious laughter at his own lapse in logic. It requires no context about the game to appreciate the human moment.
